mentions.name: Public STUN/TURN/MQTT/NTP Server Monitor
mentions.description: A server monitor for public STUN, TURN, MQTT, and NTP servers, built recently with the p2pd networking library. It checks the servers on a 4-hour interval to avoid spamming them.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built this recently with it: http://ovh1.p2pd.net:8000/servers (server monitor for public STUN, TURN, MQTT, and NTP servers. Only checks every 4 hours to avoid spamming them though.)
